decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 3 - The building shall be adapted so as to provide sound insulation against internally generated noise of not less than 30 dB(A) with windows shut and other means of ventilation provided.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the slimming and fitness centre shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 5 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The use as a fitness and slimming centre shall not commence until a scheme to protect the safety and security of customers entering and leaving the building has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing
description: Change of use at 1st floor level to provide a health & fitness centre
